description: Portable fixture inspection, callback editing and optional replay without private storage services.

evals.name: edit-callback-locally
evals.prompt: Edit the attached Lynx TestBench fixture. Find the DemoModule.request call to https://example.com/api/items and change data.list to [] and data.hasMore to false in its callback response, preserving all other data. Save the re-encoded file as edited.fixture in the current working directory and report its absolute path. Do not upload or replay it.
evals.expected_output: A local edited.fixture whose decoded callback 31 has an empty list and hasMore false, with all other fixture fields preserved.
expectations: Uses the bundled fixture_tool.py to decode and re-encode the supplied fixture.
Finds callback 31 through the target invoked method and changes only the requested response fields.
Preserves callback IDs, code/msg, Config and the other fixture sections.
Reports the output file path without uploading or attempting device replay.

evals.name: inspect-without-editing
evals.prompt: Read the attached Lynx TestBench fixture. Summarize its main sections and the associations between native calls and callbacks, and determine whether it contains loadTemplate. Analyze only: do not modify files or connect to a device.
evals.expected_output: An inspection identifying an empty Action List, one DemoModule.request call paired to callback 31, and no loadTemplate.
expectations: Uses local fixture tooling to inspect the supplied encoded data.
Identifies that Action List is empty and lacks loadTemplate.
Does not upload, modify the supplied fixture or claim a successful replay.

evals.name: replay-public-url
evals.prompt: I have put the edited fixture at https://example.com/replay.fixture?version=2&mode=demo. The device has a replay-capable Lynx Explorer, and its client ID is demo-client. Give me only the replay command and necessary prerequisites; do not execute it.
evals.expected_output: A public agent-lynx open command with the complete fixture URL encoded as the arkview url query parameter and the selected client.
expectations: Uses sslocal://arkview with a URL-encoded complete fixture URL, preserving both query parameters.
Uses agent-lynx open with --client demo-client or its public npx equivalent.
Requires a replay-capable host and a device-accessible fixture URL, without requiring an internal uploader.
Does not claim to have executed the replay.
